summary: Ambev S.A. furnished a 6-K containing an extract of minutes from its Board of Directors meeting held October 7, 2026, filed October 14, 2026. Directors unanimously ratified the appointment of Fernando Maffessoni as Vice President of Logistics, effective September 1, 2026, previously approved May 15 and July 29, 2026 and registered with the São Paulo Board of Trade. Exhibit I consolidates the executive officers, with terms unified until December 31, 2027. This is a routine governance/management appointment disclosure, not a forced or abrupt departure, so no special-situation event is present; no deal terms, advisors, or recommendations apply.
